ShippingPage.metaDescription: OBFLO shipping times, costs and 30-day return policy. Free shipping over €60.
ShippingPage.title: Shipping & returns.
ShippingPage.intro: Honest delivery times and simple returns: here's how it works.

sections.title: Shipping times
paragraphs: Orders are prepared and shipped within 1 to 3 business days. Allow 8 to 20 days between order and delivery in metropolitan France. A tracking number is emailed to you as soon as your order ships.

sections.title: Shipping costs
paragraphs: Shipping is free over €60. Below that, costs are calculated at checkout based on destination and shown before payment — no surprises.

sections.title: 30-day returns
paragraphs: You have 30 days after delivery to return a product, no questions asked. It just needs to be complete and in good condition. Contact us before sending anything back: return shipping is at your expense (except for defective products or our error), and the full refund goes out as soon as the product reaches us.

sections.title: Defective products
paragraphs: If a product arrives damaged or fails under normal use, we replace or refund it — photos are enough, no mandatory return for obvious cases.

ContactPage.faqText: Questions about heating, USB power, returns and delivery times are already covered in the <faqLink>FAQ</faqLink>.

TermsPage.metaDescription: Terms of sale for the OBFLO shop.
TermsPage.title: Terms of sale.
TermsPage.intro: Version applicable to any order placed on the OBFLO website.
TermsPage.s1P1: These terms govern sales concluded between Opcodia LLC (1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, Ste R, Albuquerque, NM 87110, USA) and any customer placing an order on the OBFLO website.
TermsPage.s2P1: Prices are shown in euros, all taxes included, excluding shipping. Shipping costs are displayed before order confirmation. Shipping is free over €60 in metropolitan France.
TermsPage.s3P1: Orders are final once payment is confirmed. Accepted payment methods: bank card (plus Apple Pay / Google Pay depending on device). Payments are secured by Stripe; no card data ever touches our servers.
TermsPage.s4P1: Orders ship within 1 to 3 business days, with tracked delivery 8 to 20 days after the order in metropolitan France. If delivery is delayed by more than 7 business days, the customer may cancel the order for a full refund.
TermsPage.s5P1: Under the French Consumer Code, customers have 14 days to withdraw. OBFLO extends this to 30 days after delivery, no questions asked. Return shipping costs are borne by the customer, except for defective products or our error. The full refund is issued once the returned product arrives complete and in good condition.
TermsPage.s6P1: All products carry the legal warranties of conformity (2 years) and against hidden defects. For a defective product: replacement or refund, at the customer's choice.
TermsPage.s7P1: For any question or claim: sav@obflo.com. Reply within 1–2 business days.
TermsPage.s8P1: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, please write to us first at contact@obflo.com: an amicable solution will be sought before any legal action.

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: OBFLO privacy and data protection policy.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy.
PrivacyPage.intro: What we collect, why, and what you can demand. Short and honest version.
PrivacyPage.s1P1: When you order: name, delivery address, email, phone number (for the carrier). When you subscribe to the newsletter: email only. Payment data is handled directly by Stripe and never touches our servers.
PrivacyPage.s2P1: Your data is used to prepare, ship and track your order, answer your support requests, and — if you opted in — send you our offers. It is never sold.
PrivacyPage.s3P1: Data strictly necessary for shipping is shared with our logistics partners and carriers, including outside the European Union, for the sole purpose of fulfilling your order. Hosting: Vercel Inc.
PrivacyPage.s4P1: Access, rectification, deletion, portability, objection: write to rgpd@obflo.com. Reply within 30 days. You may also contact the CNIL (cnil.fr).
PrivacyPage.s5P1: The site sets audience and advertising measurement cookies (Google Analytics, Google Ads) only if you accept them via the consent banner. Declining takes nothing away from how the site works. You can change your mind by clearing the site data in your browser.
